_about: The NAME MAP for the Hebrew-canonical row `legalese-he`. Every identifier of the English row `../legalese` maps to exactly one Hebrew identifier. `../../source/revoice.py` reads this file and the five English modules and emits the five Hebrew modules; it also regenerates GLOSSARY.md from this file, so the two cannot drift. The English row is the oracle: if a number ever disagrees, the bug is here, not there.

_source_codes.law: the words are the Law's own (חוק הסדרת העיסוק בעבודה במערכת קירור או מיזוג אוויר, התשפ״ה–2025), see source/law.wiki
_source_codes.schedule: the words are the Second Schedule's own (תוספת שנייה), see source/law.wiki
_source_codes.regulations: the words are the Fees Regulations' own (תקנות ... (אגרות)), see source/regulations-fees.wiki
_source_codes.composed: no counterpart in either instrument; coined here, and the note says why

comment_blocks._why: s.3(a), quoted in translation in the English row; the Hebrew original is in source/law.wiki
en: -- s.3(a): a person shall not perform work of a kind listed in column B of the
-- First Schedule on a system unless holding a licence of the type in column A
-- suited to that system. The First Schedule's lists of WORKS per grade are not
-- modelled (NOTES.md section 7), so this rule answers only the cooling-output
-- half of s.3(a): whether the licence grade reaches the system. Whether the
-- particular action is one that grade may perform is a separate question.
-- s.3(b), the Minister's power to exempt system types by order, is an input.
he: -- s.3(a): „לא יבצע אדם עבודה במערכת קירור או מיזוג אוויר כמפורט בטור ב׳ בתוספת
-- הראשונה אלא אם כן בידו רישיון מהסוג המתאים לביצוע עבודה באותה מערכת כמפורט
-- בטור א׳ בתוספת הראשונה, ובהתאם לתנאי רישיונו ולהוראות לפי חוק זה.“
-- The First Schedule's lists of WORKS per grade are not modelled (../legalese/NOTES.md
-- section 7), so this rule answers only the cooling-output half of s.3(a): whether the
-- licence grade reaches the system. Whether the particular action is one that grade may
-- perform is a separate question. s.3(b), the Minister's power to exempt system types by
-- order, is an input.
